profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Professional Interests: Software Engineering, Computer Vision, Robotics, Computational Mathematics, Computational Fluid Dynamics, Numerical Analysis, Finite Element Methods.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed autonomous behaviors deployed across 100s of autonomous surface vehicles operating in real-world maritime environments.
• Developed a framework for Text to Speech and Speech to Text from the ground up for onboard human-robot interaction.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python · ROS2 · Git · MILP · Linear Programming

positions.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Project technical lead for a robotic arm used in the manufacture of composite wings.
• Developed complete robotics pick and place solution leveraging ROS2, py_trees Behavior Trees,
and object localization via YOLO.
• Instrumented a complete CI/CD allowing for consistent dev environments, testing, and enforcing
code standards.
• Advised student interns (graduate and undergraduate) on projects ranging from end-effector
design to damage detection using AI.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · C++ · ROS2 · Containerization · Docker · Computer Vision · OpenCV · Git

positions.title: Senior Perception Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented computer vision algorithms and solutions for LiDARs leveraging
ROS2, Python, and NumPy.
• Developed both regression and unit testing to ensure code correctness.
• Developed a QT based application to curate data for use in regression testing.

positions.title: Perception Software Engineer  III
positions.description: • Developed and implemented computer vision algorithms and solutions for LiDARs leveraging ROS2 for autonomous mobile robots.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: • Software design and implementation for autonomous mobile robots for industrial applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Created a robot simulator for localization coverage testing, which allowed us to determine a priori AprilTag placements, such that we met our milestone without extensive real world testing.
• Created a package observation/segmentation pipeline based on 3D point clouds, using PCL, to detect packages, determine approximate case pose and case size.
• Wrote C++ drivers for IMUs, cameras, and LiDAR.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Computer Vision · OpenCV · Point Cloud Library (PCL) · Git

positions.title: Principal Computer Scientist
positions.description:
• Shortened release cycle from two years down to six months through agile methodologies.
• Shifted build system from make to CMake, allowing for multiple build types and options.
• Transitioned team into a git workflow improving speed, efficiency, and ease of collaborative development.
• Encouraged modern programming techniques, including a shift to C++11 and FORTRAN95, which has improved both readability of the code and reduced the overall number of lines in the code base.
• Rewrote test suite in Python, instead of make, which has improved reliability, readability, and ease of debugging, reducing down time due to unforeseen complications related to bugs.

positions.title: Senior R&D Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Core developer for ESMCI (Earth System Model Computation Infrastructure).
• Developer for E3SM (Energy Exascale Earth System Model).
• Converted the build, test, and run suite (CIME, Common Infrastructure for Modeling the Earth) from Python2 to Python3.
• Sped up test run times by up to two fold using implementing load balancing schemes specific to individual tests.
• Implemented course grid tests to improve test suite run times.
positions.insights: Skills: Fortran 95 · Python · High Performance Computing · Git

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description:
• Core developer for HART: High performance computing for simulation of patient specific cardiac systems based on the MOOSE framework.
• Coupled electrophysiology, mechanics, and fluids models using a parallel (C++ and MPI) scalar transfer based on multi-grid/multi-level methods.
• Transferred data from an external api (MOOSE/PETSc) to our internal api (MoonoLith) ensuring minimal communication across compute nodes.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
positions.description:
• Reduced code repetition for users by adding an extra layer of abstraction for FEniCS/Dolfin in Python.
• Developed a black box Python code providing “lay person” accessibility to methods for optimization and mesh adaptivity in finite elements.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) · Applied Mathematics · NumPy · Git

company.name: BCAM - Basque Center for Applied Mathematics

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Lead recitation for Vector Geometry.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed a C1 conforming FE formulation of the Pure Streamfunction form of the Quasigeostrophic Equations.
• Proved optimal error estimates for a high order finite element discretization (Argyris Finite
Element) of the Pure Streamfunction formulation of the Quasigeostrophic Equations.
• Developed the corresponding code for the above C1 finite element using a combination of MatLab, C, and Python.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Taught Calculus I.
• Lead recitation for Vector Geometry.

positions.title: Graduate Student Intern
positions.description: • Developed a polygon clipping algorithm, based on the Greiner-Hormann algorithm, which effectively dealt with degeneracies cases. The resultant code was used in HOMME, the atmospheric portion of the ACME climate model.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: • Developed an agent based model to simulate the gene flow in Cornus florida allowing for the comparison of abiotic versus biotic means of pollination.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Taught Introduction to Contemporary Mathematics.

positions.title: Groundwater Modeler
positions.description: • Analyzed regional aquifer response to groundwater withdrawals, calculating areas of impact and the response of the seawater toe, along the Coastal Plane and Eastern Shore of Virginia, allowing for proper issuing of groundwater withdrawal permits.

positions.title: Groundwater Modeler
positions.description: • Wrote scripts (Perl) to parse out and collect data for pre and post processing of Monte Carlo simulations of large scale flow and transport models allowing for the analysis of results in parallel across multiple computer nodes.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: • Developed code (FORTRAN) to solve the Henry’s Problem of Seawater Intrusion at a much finer resolution than was previously possible, allowing for more realistic simulations.
